entries.category_description: Supply of goods and services by organisations recognised as being devoted to social wellbeing by Member States and engaged in welfare or social security work
entries.comment: The supply of services by old people’s homes etc in the framework of social wellbeing, in so far as they are not exempt pursuant to Article 27 of the Greek VAT Code
